## About
Alamo Card House is a card room on Perrin Beitel in San Antonio, where locals and out-of-town players sit down for a game of poker.
We keep the doors open late every night of the week, so there is room for you whether you come by after work or well after dinner.

## Services
- Poker: Sit down at the table for a game of poker with San Antonio regulars and visitors.
- Bombpot nights: Bombpot nights with a bad beat jackpot that a player called fair.

## FAQ
Q: How late are you open on weekdays?
A: Monday through Friday we open at 10 AM and run until 3 AM. Weekends start a little later in the day.

Q: Where are you located?
A: You will find us at 9323 Perrin Beitel #103, San Antonio, TX 78217.

Q: Can I play if I am just visiting town?
A: Yes. A reviewer stopped in while visiting, found the staff attentive and friendly, and said they will be back on their next trip.
